orca orchestration inbox

Usage: orca orchestration inbox [--limit <n>] [--terminal <handle>] [--full] [--json]

Show messages across (or for) recipients

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code
  --environment
  --limit <n>            Maximum number of rows to return
  --terminal <handle>  Runtime-issued terminal handle
  --full                 Include all supported V1 issue context within caps
